text: dsh-file-finder 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的工作区文件查找插件。它在界面中提供文件搜索面板、设置页和会话看板，并注册 file_finder 工具供 agent 搜索、读取和保存文件。用户可以按名称、路径片段或内容查找文件，在目录浏览、原生预览、内置查看器和文本编辑器之间切换；查看器支持常见图片、视频、音频、PDF、HTML 与 Markdown。编辑器提供语法着色、行号和文件内查找，并通过工作区文件系统保存文本。会话看板展示待处理、运行中和最近结束的会话。需要在 DSH 中安装插件，不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-file-finder adds workspace search, preview, editing, and a session board to DSH Web. Search by file name, path, or content; browse folders and open files in the native preview, viewer, or text editor. The file_finder agent tool can search, read, and save text. No API key is required.
想按文件名或路径片段快速找到工作区里的文件。
能不能在 DSH 里直接搜索文件内容并定位匹配行？
希望不输入关键词也能浏览当前工作区的目录和文件。
我想在搜索结果里预览图片、视频、PDF 或 Markdown。
需要一个能编辑工作区文本文件并保存的界面。
想在代码文件编辑时看行号、语法颜色并查找文件内文本。
有没有办法从 DSH agent 工具搜索并读取项目文件？
我想快速查看哪些会话正在运行或等待我处理。
dsh-file-finder 的功能「按名称查找」：在当前工作区按文件名或路径片段搜索，并按匹配程度排序后返回文件路径。可通过面板搜索触发。
dsh-file-finder 的功能「按内容查找」：扫描工作区文本文件并返回匹配内容的行号和片段；内容查询至少需要两个字符。可在面板切换到内容搜索。
dsh-file-finder 的功能「预览与编辑文件」：从搜索结果打开文件，可选择 DSH 原生预览、内置查看器或编辑器；编辑器保存 UTF-8 文本。
dsh-file-finder 的功能「Agent 文件工具」：注册 file_finder 工具，让 agent 列出工作区、按名称或内容搜索，并读取或保存文本文件。

dsh-file-finder README · dsh-file-finder：A DeepSeek Harness plugin for finding workspace files without leaving DSH: search by file name or by file content, browse the workspace when there is nothing to type, then open the result in DSH's native preview, the plugin's own viewer, or the built-in editor.

[中文文档](README.zh.md)

▶ **36-second tour (English, captions):** [dsh-file-finder-promo.mp4](docs/media/video/dsh-file-finder-promo.mp4) · [中文版](docs/media/video/dsh-file-finder-promo-zh.mp4)

dsh-file-finder README · What it does：- **Browse when there is nothing to search**: with an empty query the palette lists the current workspace directory — folders first, then files — and you can walk into a folder (Enter or →), go back up (Backspace) or jump with the breadcrumb. Typing switches to the normal search, and clearing the query returns to the folder you were browsing. **Escape** walks back one screen at a time: from a viewer or the editor to the folder you opened it from, then up through the folders, and only then closes the panel.
- **Search by file name**, including a path fragment such as `src/view`.
- **Search by content**, with one result row per matching line.
- **Choose where files open**: one global **Open mode** picks which File surface Enter uses for text — **Native preview** (DSH's right-sidebar document preview, the default), the plugin's own **Viewer** (read-only, with syntax colours and in-file find) or the **Editor** (saves through DSH's workspace filesystem and refuses to overwrite a file that changed after it was loaded). Cmd/Ctrl+Enter always opens the other side of view/edit.
- **Media always uses the Viewer**: images, video, audio, PDFs, HTML and Mar

dsh-file-finder README · File system: it already uses DSH's：| Operation | Owner |
| --- | --- |
| Walking, reading, writing workspace files | DSH's `ctx.fs` seam (`index.js`) |
| Search and ranking | This plugin (DSH exposes no reusable search service) |
| Opening in the Native preview | DSH's right-sidebar document preview, via `ctx.sidebarRight.openResource()` and a `dsh-resource://file/session/<sessionId>/<path>` address |
| Opening in the Viewer | This plugin's read-only surface, rendered inside its own overlay |
| Editing and conflict checks | This plugin's editor, over the same `ctx.fs` seam |

text:
dsh-file-finder README · File system: it already uses DSH's：The plugin is deliberately **additive**: it registers nothing into DSH's own file surfaces (no document renderer, no right-sidebar tab type, no shadowing of the Files tree), so DSH updates keep applying and uninstalling the plugin leaves DSH exactly as it was. This is recorded in [ADR 0001](docs/adr/0001-file-surfaces-stay-additive.md).

When the native preview is unavailable (no live Session, or a shell without the right sidebar), the plugin falls back to the Viewer and says so.

text:
dsh-file-finder README · Shortcuts：| Action | Default keys |
| --- | --- |
| Search by file name | Cmd/Ctrl+P |
| Search by content | Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+F |
| Toggle DS Bot / classic Agent mode (only with the DS Bot plugin installed) | Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+B |

dsh-file-finder README · Shortcuts：The commands are registered with DSH's shortcut service so you can assign your own keys in **Settings → Edit shortcuts**, but they declare **no default binding**. DSH's registry throws when one command's default overlaps another's, and it throws from inside the *other* plugin's `apply()`, so claiming Cmd+Shift+F here took the whole Web UI boot down (`Conflicting shortcut defaults: session.fork and files.searchContent`). The VS Code keys above are served by this plugin's own keydown handler instead.

dsh-file-finder README · Shortcuts：Note that Cmd+Shift+F is DSH's own "fork session" binding; this plugin uses it for content search, so rebind `session.fork` in **Settings → Edit shortcuts** if you relied on it.

dsh-file-finder README · Shortcuts：In the browser Web shell (not the desktop app), Cmd+Shift+B is DSH's right-sidebar toggle. With DS Bot installed this plugin takes that key for the mode switch, so assign a different key to `files.toggleBotMode` in **Settings → Edit shortcuts** if you need the sidebar binding there. On the desktop app the combination is free.

dsh-file-finder README · DS Bot mode switch (optional)：When the DS Bot plugin (`ds-bot`) is part of the running boot, this plugin also offers **Toggle Bot / classic Agent mode** on Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+B, plus a matching card in **Settings → File Finder**.

dsh-file-finder README · DS Bot mode switch (optional)：DS Bot keeps its surface switch private — it exposes no client service — so the bridge does the two things another plugin safely can: it detects `ds-bot` in the boot graph, and it drives the controls DS Bot renders itself (the account menu's surface-switch entry to leave Bot mode, and the DS Bot return pill to come back). Nothing is patched or forked, and DS Bot's own `ds-bot:surface` preference stays authoritative.

dsh-file-finder README · DS Bot mode switch (optional)：Without DS Bot nothing is registered or shown: the command never reaches **Settings → Edit shortcuts**, the settings card stays hidden, and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+B is left to whatever else owns it.

dsh-file-finder README · Settings：**Settings → File Finder** covers:

- Shortcut reference with one-click try buttons, including **Open file browser** (no default binding)
- Case sensitivity
- Extra ignored directory names (with live chips)
- Name and content result limits (steppers)
- The global Open mode: **Native preview**, **Viewer** or **Editor** (media always opens in the Viewer)
- Reset to defaults; changes save automatically

dsh-file-finder README · Editing：Choose a result and press Cmd/Ctrl+Enter (or set the built-in editor as the default action). Save writes the full text back through the workspace filesystem and refuses to overwrite a file that changed after it was loaded. Reload, then save again, to take the newer version. The editor is for UTF-8 text under about 1 MB. Binary files and common build or dependency directories are skipped.

dsh-file-finder README · Editing：Escape in the viewer returns to the folder you opened the file from; the same key works while a previewed HTML page has focus, because the host injects a small Escape forwarder into the served document.

dsh-file-finder README · Editing：Files that are not text open in the built-in viewer instead: images, video and audio render inline (byte ranges, so video seeking works), PDFs open in the platform frame, HTML pages run in a sandboxed iframe whose scripts cannot reach DSH, and Markdown is rendered with DSH's Markdown renderer, with an **Edit source** button that hands the file to the text editor.

dsh-file-finder README · Editing：Hold **Cmd/Ctrl** in the editor and every identifier that resolves gains a dotted underline and a pointer: hovering shows its kind, its declaration and the line, and Cmd/Ctrl-click jumps to the definition. **Cmd/Ctrl+[** (or the back button in the header) returns to where you came from. Resolution is same-file for now — the declaration scan covers JS/TS, Python, Go, Rust, Java/C-like, HTML anchors and a generic fallback; project-wide TypeScript resolution is the next phase.

dsh-file-finder README · Editing：Text is coloured lexically: keywords, types, strings, numbers, comments, calls, properties and HTML/CSS/JSON/Markdown markup each get their own colour in both DSH themes. Markup files also colour what hides inside them — Vue/Svelte/HTML `<script>` blocks run the script scanner, `<style>` blocks the CSS one, and Vue `{{ }}` expressions and directive values (`:prop`, `@click`, `v-if`) are coloured as code — and a Markdown fenced block is coloured as the language it names. The textarea keeps the caret, selection and IME; only the visible lines are painted, so a large file scrolls without lag. Files over 200 KB fall back to plain text and say so in the header, and an open in-file search keeps the colours behind its highlight.

dsh-file-finder README · Editing：The editor shows a line-number gutter and highlights the caret's line. **Cmd/Ctrl+F** opens in-file search: every match is highlighted, the current one more strongly, with a match count, previous/next buttons, and a **Aa** case-sensitivity toggle. Enter and Shift+Enter step through matches, Escape closes the search and returns focus to the text.

dsh-file-finder README · Install：The plugin is published to npm as **`dsh-file-finder`**, so **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin** resolves the package name directly:

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-file-finder
```

Or install from this checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin add /Library/aiProject/dsh-file-finder
```

Restart or refresh the DSH page if the new client module does not appear immediately.

The same operations are available to the agent as the `file_finder` tool.

dsh-file-finder README · Development：```sh
node --check index.js
node --check client.js
npm test          # pure logic + contracts, milliseconds
npm run hooks     # git pre-push runs the same gate (`.githooks/`)

CI runs the same unit gate on every push and pull request.

dsh-file-finder README · Development：`npm test` covers the search helpers, the Desktop opener's host action and refusal list, the shortcut-default regression guard, and the UI contract (native preview address, palette hooks, reduced-motion rules, the DS Bot bridge, and the editor's line gutter, in-file find and syntax colours).

Browser checks are split by feature:

```sh
npm run check:find
npm run check:viewer
npm run check:intel
npm run check:tokens

dsh-file-finder README · Development：The DS Bot bridge also has a browser check that runs the real key handler against DS Bot's real selectors, with and without `ds-bot` in the boot graph:

```sh
node preview/bot-check.mjs
```

The native-integration research — address grammar, session derivation, service access, HMR behavior, and the keep-vs-delegate matrix — is documented in [docs/native-integration.md](docs/native-integration.md).

dsh-file-finder README · Development：`preview/` is a dev-only harness that renders the palette and settings page outside DSH with the real DSH theme tokens, and captures light/dark screenshots with Playwright:

```sh
node preview/screenshot.mjs
```

It is not part of the published package.
